companyFieldUpdates.description: Electrada, LLC was a U.S. commercial fleet-charging platform that financed, owned and managed charging infrastructure under charging-as-a-service arrangements. Launched in 2020 and headquartered in Cincinnati, the company served commercial, institutional and public fleets through no-upfront-capex infrastructure and energy-management contracts. BlackRock Climate Infrastructure backed Electrada beginning in 2021, but the exact fund, vehicle and stake were not publicly disclosed. On April 20, 2026, Current Trucking acquired Electrada's operating, construction and development assets, more than 30 sites, customer agreements and select personnel. On June 17, 2026, Inspiration Mobility acquired select remaining assets, team, pipeline, depot-development capability, energy software and intellectual property. Those transactions ended Electrada as a standalone operating platform; neither buyer is treated as a full legal successor and no GIP ownership period exists.
